description: Research-integrity registry: instrument identity, provenance, licensing, reserved evaluation windows, and permanently consumed windows. Consulted by crypto_paper_lab.researchguard at every strategy-executing entry point and shape-checked by crypto_paper_lab.registry_schema. Absence or malformation of this file causes evaluation to be REFUSED, never permitted. Metadata is validated: contradictory or incomplete entries are refused, not normalised.

metadata_conventions.timestamp_normalized_tz: Every timestamp in this file is UTC. A non-UTC value is refused rather than converted, because a silent conversion would change the data it describes.
metadata_conventions.provenance_grade: A = values independently re-derived from source; B = verified against publisher checksums only; C = single-source, unverified; UNVERIFIED = no independent check performed.
metadata_conventions.licence_knowledge: VERIFIED = licence terms confirmed in writing and recorded; UNVERIFIED = terms not established; RESTRICTED = terms prohibit the intended use.
metadata_conventions.volume_semantics: What the volume column actually holds. 'tick' is a count of price changes and is NOT a traded quantity; 'none' means the source has none and it must never be fabricated.
metadata_conventions.research_approval: A governance state, not a data-quality property. RESEARCH_APPROVED additionally requires approved_preregistration_id and is unreachable by data quality alone.
metadata_conventions.timestamp_convention: Whether a bar OPENS or CLOSES at its timestamp, or whether the row is an instantaneous fixing. Identical-looking timestamps with different meanings are a silent off-by-one-bar error.

instruments.licence_note: Binance publishes market data for research use. Redistribution terms are not established in this repository and are recorded as UNVERIFIED rather than assumed.
instruments.provenance_note: Publisher checksums plus independent re-derivation in Phase 5 and Phase 29C. Every merged candle was re-derived from the raw monthly archives.
instruments.volume_note: Binance spot base-asset volume. Not comparable to another venue's figure without adjustment.
instruments.spread_note: No bid/ask data was acquired. Spread cannot be modelled; this is a stated limitation, not an assumption of zero cost.

consumed_windows.note: Primary research dataset, used from Phase 5 onward across 12+ configuration searches.
Phase 29 holdout, evaluated exactly once under a frozen pre-registration.

instruments.research_note: All three available BTC windows are spent. Used from Phase 5 onward for 12+ configuration searches; the Phase 10/11 OOS window and the Phase 29 holdout were each consumed once. No untouched BTC data remains.

instruments.licence_note: Same provider and same unestablished redistribution terms as BTC/USDT.
instruments.provenance_note: Phase 34 re-derived all 24,288 rows with zero mismatches. Phase 35 corrected twelve 2024 sidecars from microseconds to milliseconds; twenty-nine later sidecars genuinely are microseconds.
instruments.spread_note: No bid/ask data was acquired. Spread cannot be modelled.
instruments.research_note: Data quality is the strongest in the repository. Research approval is nevertheless withheld: no preregistration is frozen, no thresholds exist, and no cross-asset authorization record exists for carrying the BTC-derived configuration onto ETH data.

instruments.licence_note: ECB reference rates are published under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Non-commercial use only, share-alike, attribution required. Commercial use is excluded.
instruments.attribution_string: Source: European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rates.
instruments.provenance_note: Publisher-published figures verified against the acquisition manifest; no independent re-derivation is possible for an official fixing.
instruments.volume_note: No volume of any kind exists in this source. It must never be inferred or fabricated.
instruments.spread_note: Not applicable to a reference fixing, and its absence is the reason this source cannot support trade-level research.
instruments.blocker: Not OHLCV. A single published fixing per day carries no intraday high or low, so there is no traded price range. Separately, no session, holiday or DST validator exists in this repository, and inventing one would mean validating data against an invented calendar.
instruments.research_note: Reference rates are usable for long-horizon context only. Converting them into synthetic OHLC would fabricate the volatility a strategy trades on.
instruments.retrieval_endpoint_note: Phase 33 retrieved these fixings through frankfurter.app, an open-source API over ECB reference rates. frankfurter.app is the retrieval path, not the publisher; ECB is the publisher. Licence terms recorded here are ECB's.

Warm-up bars are indicator context only and contribute no trades. Phase 42 confirmed enforcement is live across all six strategy-executing entry points, and that no ETH 2026 performance has been computed or inspected.
